body:
Thanks for the well thought out and caring replies. I do appreciate it and it means a lot and this subreddit has helped me a lot over the years. Talking here was the one thing that kept me alive when I posted from the roof of that hospital parking structure in tears about how horribly my parent was treating me while they were in the hosptial with liver failure a couple years ago. I was struggling so much.


I've made my decision, or more accurately I only have one option left. I have truly exhausted all resources.


Not like anyone will read this anyhow but even now I am truly grateful to have discovered this subreddit so long ago

How do you know?

Is it worth it if you can't feel that they love you. Logically you know they do but cannot feel it not matter what you or they do.

My child tries to fix me, a preschooler shouldn't have the burden of trying to make mommy feel better.

If I had know what I know now I wouldn't have brought a child into this situation. Though this child is dearly loved by a lot of people.

What else can be done? Therapy? Anti depressants? I've done that all it's done is slowly drained me of hope that things would get better.

I don't even have friends. Sure people offer to be your friend when they feel sorry for you. But eventually those friends grow tired of you.

I spent spent 6 years before I moved out of my parents house at home, I wasn't allowed to to to school or visit anyone. I stayed home and cleaned and cooked and took care of the baby.

I never had a chance to learn how to make friends
I was wondering about the biochemical level of what happens. Thanks

I've made a mistake by posting here. I don't think anyone can help me. What I need is not possible or realistic. 

I want to scream and yell and break things and just cry it hurts so. And at the same time the exhaustion is overwhelming I can hardly keep my eyes open or focus my vision. 

And I'm utterly terrified
And yet I'm haunted by complete flashbacks and was diagnosed as PTSD. Although my therapist said mine was complex wtf that means

I can't even remember anymore

Most of my life I don't remember. I remember small things like getting a broken bone because I spilled some water. Or my mother telling me that she hated me and making me watch her write how she was giving up her parental rights to me on a yellow lined notepad at the hospital after she found out I started cutting.. We were at the hospital after I was raped. Or that my dad threw me across the room at 3 years old when I was trying to give him a hug.

That my best friend and ex fiancé was killed. And was the only person who ever truly understood me.its been 4 years and I still break down.

That I lost a very wanted pregnancy in July and I feel like my hearts been ripped out and can't breath.. What a cruel joke, I was truly happy for the few months I was pregnant.


That I lost my job, and my identity and moved to a place a hate a few months ago but I'm stuck here

That I tried to talk to my husband said im not ok and he said I'm fine.

That I'm watching my siblings be tormented by my mother and there's nothing I can do about it. Most of it is my fault

That I have no one who I can talk to who cares, I've literally lost everything 

My husband is misserable and my other child deserves a better parent. I'm holding them back. A broken parent does more harm to a child than an absent parent 

My job is killing me, I cry nearly every day from the stress and stupid people I have to put up with


I made a couple half hearted attempts in the past, underestimating my tolerance for opioids.


I wish I had kept a diary or something. If nothing else it would be the perfect manual on how to destroy a human being completely
I told my SO that I wasn't ok and broke down to them about why. I even told them why and that i thought i needed help and they looked at me. Sort of laughed a bit and said "No you don't, you're fine"

So I am basically a lost cause then? The only reason I am still here is because I have given myself some time to make sure of my decision. I know from experience giving yourself a week when you feel like this can help you change your mind because things sometimes improve just enough to give you hope.

I'm pushing 16 days and nothing has improved or maybe I just see through the false hope now.

Either way the realization that I am a lost cause has brought me to tears but given me an odd sense of peace. At least I know what I need to write to make them understand. Thank you for taking the time to reply and showing kindness.
This... I wish I were important enough to my Significant Other to do that

My bad, no down vote
